Shanghai Municipal Council.
June 12th 1916.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
All the troops were paid on 10th inst.
The running of goods trains from Shanghai to Hangchow has been resumed.
It is reported that Deputy Military Governor Lu, Woosung, has sent a telegram to President Li Yuan Hung saying that the Kuomintang party in Shanghai are plotting against him and that General Yang is assisting it.
A later report says that General Yang has been instructed by the Central Government to report on the doings of the Kuomintang society in Shanghai.
It is reported that the Kuomintang party here are anxious to have Chen Chi Mei's coffin removed to the western lake, Hangchow where they intend to erect a mosoleum.
It is reported that an attempt has been made to poison Chou Ching Tsan 周金咸 Taoyin of Shanghai. The Taoyin's second cook who is suspected of being concerned in the plot has run away.
It is reported that Admiral Li Ting Sung 李鼎新 who has been in seclusion since the Chao Ho incident, will resume his duties as an Admiral soon.
Two new newspapers have appeared in Shanghai to-day. One of them called "the New Republic" is said to have been started by Sun Yat Sen. It is published at No.14 Rue de Consulat. The other which is called Sing Tsoong Nga Pao 新中報 has its office at No.417 Hankow Road and is said to be the property of Marshal Feng Kuo Chang.

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
Entered on MS June 12.

A°
391
14/6/16
上海工部局。
1916年6月12日。
（印：上海工部局警务处）

警务处，
（侦探股。）

先生：
所有部队已于本月10日发饷。
上海至杭州的货运列车已恢复运行。
据报，吴淞副督军卢永祥已致电总统黎元洪，称上海的国民党人正密谋反对他，而杨将军正在协助此举。
后续报告称，中央政府已指示杨将军汇报上海国民党社团的活动情况。
据报，本地国民党人急于将陈其美的灵柩迁往杭州西湖，并拟在那里修建陵墓。
据报，有人企图毒害上海道尹周金咸。涉嫌参与该阴谋的道尹的二厨已潜逃。
据报，自“肇和”舰事件以来一直隐居的海军上将李鼎新，即将复职履行海军上将职责。
今日上海出现两份新报纸。其中一份名为《新共和》（The New Republic），据称由孙中山创办，出版地址为领事馆路14号。另一份名为《新中報》，社址位于汉口路417号，据称归冯国璋元帅所有。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
总探长。

警察总监。
于6月12日录入手稿。
